“Theydies and Gentlethems of Empire City, this is your prevalent host Finn Midask here with the truth. Before we get down to business a few updates around town.

Due to community outreach efforts and aid provided by local citizens like yourselves, Ferrytown games have been restocked, repaired and are open once more.
Go on down and win prizes hosted by Ferrah today!

Going around the EC you will find that the taxes have shifted further. 
If you’re traveling through Hampstead, beware any spells you cast. They will be significantly less effective. Don’t rely on top tier healing for the day while strolling about.

In addition to the raised prices and weakened spell penetration it is now more difficult to get a good night’s rest. 

Those brave or insane souls that sleep outside in Ferrytown are finding themselves waking up a whole hour later than their normal body clocks.
This seems to be the result of low ambient magic in the area.

Bringing us to the business: There’s trouble brewing down there across the bay and it’s imperative that we get there according to a figure named Sutri.

Reports have indicated that local animals have been feeling lethargic and hungry after Leylines in the city have been sapped of its reserve.

Could this be related to the drill incident in Central Park tapping into the cornerstone of our city? Or just a surprise coincidence affecting magically dependent creatures, we hope to find out tonight.

**All able bodies PLEASE REPORT TO Ferrytown Hilltops at 7pm.** From there we will mount a defense and investigation around a supporting essential tree of life that sustains the magical atmosphere.

It is unlikely that there is a higher imperative than this one. Get armed, get armored, and run on down!

As for tomorrow, stand by for fringe operations to take back a piece of power from the lobsters and organize at the Samuel Adams. Come ready to join the crew by air or ground and we’ll place you.

This has been Finn Midask with the Truth, signing off”
